text: (--)-alpha-Bisabolol has a primary antipeptic action depending on dosage, which is not caused by an alteration of the pH value. The proteolytic activity of pepsin is reduced by 50 percent through addition of bisabolol in the ratio of 1:0.5. However, the antipeptic action of bisabolol only occurs in case of direct contact. In case of a previous contact with the substrate, the inhibiting effect is lost.
